description.en: Enables or disables a handle (character, prop, image, ...), controlling whether it's active/visible/updated. The first argument can also be an array of handles to enable/disable them all at once.
Handle to enable or disable, or an array of handles.
True to enable, false to disable.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds, a handle doesn't resolve, or the call was invalid.

example.code:
// Hide the event-only goal collision until it's needed
CMND_SET_ENABLE(eventGoalMouseHdl, false);
